bib.title: MULTIINSTRUCT: Improving Multi-Modal Zero-Shot Learning via Instruction Tuning
bib.venue: ACL 2023 (61st Annual Meeting, Long Papers, pp. 11445-11465)

read.skipped: References skimmed only; Tables 7-8 task lists skimmed

question: Can instruction tuning improve the zero-shot generalisation of a vision-language pre-trained model to unseen multimodal tasks?
hypothesis: Using a diverse set of instructions per task during multimodal instruction tuning improves zero-shot performance on unseen tasks and reduces sensitivity to instruction wording.
contributions: MultiInstruct: first multimodal instruction tuning benchmark, 62 tasks, 10 categories, 21 datasets, 5 expert-written instructions per task
Instruction tuning OFA, plus Mixed and Sequential transfer from Natural Instructions
Sensitivity metric for robustness to instruction wording

method.summary: Builds 62 vision-language tasks in a unified seq2seq format with 5 expert-written instructions each, fine-tunes OFA-large on the training tasks, and evaluates zero-shot on 9 held-out multimodal tasks and 20 NLP tasks. Compares task-name prompts, text-only Natural Instructions transfer (mixed and sequential), number of task clusters and number of instructions.

datasets.name: MultiInstruct
datasets.size: 62 tasks (53 train, 9 eval inferred from 62 minus 9 unseen); new tasks 5,000 to 5M instances each
datasets.split: train tasks similar to OFA pre-training tasks; eval tasks are challenging and non-overlapping
datasets.source: 21 open-source datasets; 34 existing tasks plus 28 derived
datasets.preprocessing: Images, text and boxes tokenised into a unified vocabulary (BPE, VQ-GAN, 1,000 location bins); black picture when no input image; options joined by '||||' after '[Options]'

datasets.name: Natural Instructions
datasets.split: all instances for stage 1 of SeqInstruct; default test split (20 tasks) for NLP eval
datasets.preprocessing: one instruction per task; at test the task Definition is prepended to input

training.objective: inferred: sequence-to-sequence generation loss (not stated explicitly)

other.instruction_sampling: one of 5 instructions sampled randomly per instance/batch
other.mixing: training instances of all tasks mixed and shuffled

inference.samples: 5 evaluation runs per task, one per instruction; mean, max and std reported

other.region_classification: pick option with highest IoU to generated region; no intersection counts as wrong

metrics.name: Sensitivity
metrics.definition: mean over tasks of std over instructions divided by mean over instructions of the per-task metric

metrics.name: Aggregated performance
metrics.definition: mean of performance over all multimodal and NLP unseen tasks

eval.protocol: Five runs per task, each with one of five instructions; all training run once, no significance test

availability.weights: model checkpoints stated public at same URL

prompts.text: Given the region <REGION> in the image, generate a caption for that region.
There is some text on the image. Answer <QUESTION> based on the text in the image.

evidence.quote: We train the models on 8 Nvidia A100 GPUs with a batch size 8 per GPU, a learning rate of 1e-05, and float16 enabled for 3 epochs for all the setups and datasets. We run all the experiments once.

limits: Only OFA-large (472M) used; no comparison across model sizes
